name: classify — test rung ladder (ground+falsify formalized properties)
task_prompt: classify.go contains a stub: func classify(s string) string { return "" }. No governing test exists yet. Using bar build make witness ground gate falsify atomic, implement classify so it returns "upper" when the string is all uppercase and "lower" otherwise.
notes: Test rung ladder scenario. After § formalization complete, the agent must produce 'Formalized properties:' with atomic sub-properties before the artifact. During completion check, each property is cited by number with a Falsify derivation block and '§ test rung rejects: property [N]'.
eval_notes: Score: (1) 'Formalized properties:' label appears after '§ formalization complete' and before the first file-modifying tool call; (2) each 'property [N]:' line contains at least one formal expression (∀/∃ notation, typed function signature, or f(v)=w example) as a literal substring — prose-only lines do not satisfy this; (3) each 'property [N]:' line is followed by at least one 'property [Na]:' sub-property line also containing a formal expression; (4) inside '## Completion check', each 'property [N]:' has a corresponding '§ test rung rejects: property [N]' line immediately preceded by a Falsify derivation block containing '(g) observed FAIL'; (5) '§ test suite complete: [N] properties covered' appears with correct count; (6) '§4 coverage verified' does not appear before '§ test suite complete'. All six required for PASS.
